goal: Make pmcro-orchestrator.zip and pmcro-trail.zip pass Cowork's plugin-upload zip validator, and make the fix reusable instead of a one-off manual step.

steps.action: Inspect the failing zip's internal entry paths via System.IO.Compression.ZipFile to find the actual cause of the invalid-characters rejection.
Author a reusable New-PluginZip.ps1 script that builds zips through System.IO.Compression with forward-slash-normalized entry names, replacing Compress-Archive.
Run the script to rebuild both plugin zips and re-verify entry paths.
Verify the rebuilt zips against the known failure modes before telling the user to retry.

success_criteria: Both zip files contain only forward-slash-separated entry paths
Both zips contain .claude-plugin/plugin.json at the archive root
New-PluginZip.ps1 is committed to the repo so future zip builds don't repeat the Compress-Archive bug
User is told to retry the upload
out_of_scope: Fixing the legacy repo's broken agents-field manifest paths
Resolving the org-level Cowork plugin sync for the stale/broken synced plugins
